verses.en: My son, if thou wilt receive my words, and hide my commandments with thee;
verses.sm: Loʻu atalii e, afai e te talia aʻu upu, ma e teu i lou loto aʻu poloaiga,

verses.en: So that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom, and apply thine heart to understanding;
verses.sm: e uai atu ai ou taliga i le poto, e faasaga atu ai lou loto i le faautauta;

verses.en: Yea, if thou criest after knowledge, and liftest up thy voice for understanding;
verses.sm: afai lava e te valaau atu i le atamai, ma e leo tele atu i le faautauta;

verses.en: If thou seekest her as silver, and searchest for her as for hid treasures;
verses.sm: afai e te sailiili ia te ia, e pei ona sailiili i le ario; afai e te suesue i ai, pei ona suesue i le oloa lilo;

verses.en: Then shalt thou understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God.
verses.sm: ona e lagona ai lea o le mataʻu i le ALII, ma e maua ai le poto i le Atua.

verses.en: For the LORD giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding.
verses.sm: Auā o le ALI na te foai mai le poto; mai lona fofoga le poto ma le faautauta;

verses.en: He layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous: he is a buckler to them that walk uprightly.
verses.sm: na te teua le poto mo e amio saʻo; O le talita o ia i e ua tonu lo latou savali,

verses.en: He keepeth the paths of judgment, and preserveth the way of his saints.
verses.sm: ina ia leoleo i ala o lē amiotonu; e tausi foi e ia le ala o ona tagata amio Atua;

verses.en: Then shalt thou understand righteousness, and judgment, and equity; yea, every good path.
verses.sm: ona e lagona ai lea o le amiotonu, ma le faamasinoga, ma le amio saʻo; o ala lelei uma lava.

verses.en: When wisdom entereth into thine heart, and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul;
verses.sm: A oo le poto i lou loto, ma ua mālie ia te oe le atamai;

verses.en: Discretion shall preserve thee, understanding shall keep thee:
verses.sm: e faafeao le mafaufau ia te oe; e leoleo ia te oe le faautauta;

verses.en: To deliver thee from the way of the evil man, from the man that speaketh froward things;
verses.sm: ina ia laveai ia te oe ai le ala leaga; ai le tagata ua tautala i mea faapiopio;

verses.en: Who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;
verses.sm: o E tuua ala tonu, a e ui atu i ala pogisa;

verses.en: Who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the frowardness of the wicked;
verses.sm: o e fiafia e fai mea leaga; ua latou olioli i le faapiopio e leaga;

verses.en: Whose ways are crooked, and they froward in their paths:
verses.sm: o e faapiopio i o latou ala, ma vaogatata i a iatou amio;

verses.en: To deliver thee from the strange woman, even from the stranger which flattereth with her words;
verses.sm: e laveai ia te oe ai le fafine ese, o le fafine ese na te faaoleole i ana upu;

verses.en: Which forsaketh the guide of her youth, and forgetteth the covenant of her God.
verses.sm: 0 le na te tuua le na tausi ia te ia a o teine muli; ua gaio foi ia te ia le feagaiga a lona Atua.

verses.en: For her house inclineth unto death, and her paths unto the dead.
verses.sm: Aua e taunuu atu lona fale i le oti, ma ona ala i agaga o e ua oti;

verses.en: None that go unto her return again, neither take they hold of the paths of life.
verses.sm: o i latou uma o e o atu ia te ia, e le foi mai i latou; latou te-le maua ala o le ola.

verses.en: That thou mayest walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.
verses.sm: Ina ia e savali i le ala o e lelei, ma e tau iusi i ala o e amiotonu.

verses.en: For the upright shall dwell in the land, and the perfect shall remain in it.
verses.sm: Aua o e amio saʻo, latou te mau i le nuu; ma e ua sao a latou amio, e faatotoeina ai i latou;

verses.en: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth, and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it.
verses.sm: a e vavaeeseina o e amio leaga ai le laueleele, e liaiina ai foi o e amio pepelo.
